<thought>Using the ESI‑MS spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 141.115 ([M+H]⁺). Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈140.108 Da. The isotopic pattern (≈9 % M+1) indicates about 8–9 carbons. A formula that matches the exact mass and the carbon count is C₈H₁₄NO (monoisotopic mass 140.1075 Da). This fits the required format CxHyOzX, where X = N. Hence the molecular formula is C8H14NO.</thought>
<final_answer>C8H14NO</final_answer>
